ELECTRICITY — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Magnetism.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism.

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team
